text:
Sam (CS): Quick kickoff — welcome sprint for Aurelia Health. Goal: production integration + baseline health check in 30 days. Posting proposed owners, success criteria, and a lightweight timeline. Please read and claim tasks by EOD today.

Sam (CS): Stakeholders: Marta (CS lead), Priya (product sponsor), Lee (SE), Aurelia Eng: @dev-team, Exec sponsor: Claire.

Sam (CS): Proposed success criteria (pick 2-3): 1) Stable inference under 95th p50 latency target, 2) 90% of test prompts return expected intent buckets, 3) Docs and runbook handed to Aurelia SRE, 4) 1st-week NPS >= 7 from 10 pilot users.

Lee - Solutions Eng: I can own the initial integration runbook and the tech workshop. Suggest we do a 90m session to pair on auth, routing, and sample payloads.

Marta (Success): I'll own user enablement and the feedback survey. Plan: 15-min onboarding + 5-question survey at day 7 and day 30.

Ankit (SE): Happy to take API integration + test harness. Will post a short checklist.

Priya (PM): For success metrics, let's track: latency p50/p95, error rate, token cost per call, and adoption (active users/day). Agree on targets and we'll map to rollback criteria.

Sam (CS): Timeline (light):
- Day 0-3: Tech workshop + auth config (Lee, Ankit)
- Day 4-10: Integration + sample dataset tests (Ankit)
- Day 7: Enablement session + first survey (Marta)
- Day 11-20: Performance tuning, batching/quantization suggestions (SE + Eng)
- Day 21-30: Go/no-go review; handover docs + runbook (Sam/Marta)

Marta (Success): Adding a quick retention risk check: customer mentions budget sensitivity and an upcoming vendor review at day 28. We should surface early cost tradeoffs and a recommended config.

Lee - Solutions Eng: Noted — I'll prepare two cost/perf configs for Aurelia (latency-priority vs cost-priority) and include expected token/unit costs.

Ankit (SE): Checklist: auth keys, sample payloads, schema validation, end-to-end smoke test, monitoring hooks. Posting now:
```
- generate API key
- wire env vars
- run smoke test with sample payloads (script: ./smoke.sh)
- verify tracing headers
- validate output against prompt set
```

Priya (PM): Good. Also, can we add an owner for renewal-risk tracking? If the vendor review goes poorly we escalate to AE.

Sam (CS): I'll monitor renewal-risk flags and loop in AE (Jordan) if survey <6 or cost delta >25% vs baseline.

calendar-bot: Created event "Aurelia Tech Workshop" — Fri 10:00–11:30 (invite: Sam, Lee, Ankit, Marta, Priya, Aurelia dev). Link: https://cal.example.com/event/1768888129

Marta (Success): Quick ask — can we capture one short success story/screen recording once we hit stable inference? Will help enablement + case study.

Sam (CS): Yes. Add to handover: 3-min demo clip + 2 quote lines from Aurelia PM.

Lee - Solutions Eng: I'll add a folder in our shared drive for configs + demo clip.

Ankit (SE): Claiming Day 4-10 integration window. I'll post daily quick status in this thread.

Priya (PM): Thanks team. If anyone needs extra runway for perf testing, flag now.

Sam (CS): Thanks — assigning owners in our tracking doc. Will ping again after the workshop with action items. :party-parrot:
